messages:
emily.k: Solstice Health just reported increased p99 tail latency and intermittent 502s on their dedicated pool. Customer seeing timeouts on inference calls; CS flagged this as potential P1. Need owners and a short mitigation plan + ETA. Paging eng-platform. @rafa.t @cheng.li please advise.
rafa.t: I'll take routing + temporary scale. Plan: manual bump autoscaler by +2 nodes, enable fallback routing to smaller model variant. ETA ~30m to scale, 1h to fully validate. I'll open a PR for the autoscaler override.
cheng.li: I'll investigate mem pressure and KV cache. Quick check on node pool A shows GPU mem ~95% and long batch windows. Suggest reducing batch_window_ms to 10 as a hot patch. I can push a config PR now.
oncall-bot: alert: solstice-prod-dedicated - p99_latency=3.2s, errors=22 in last 10m, last_seen=2m ago. https://alerts.redwood/solstice-prod-dedicated/alert123
maria.g: Customer needs a firm workaround ETA within 1h or they'll escalate to legal. Please confirm we can meet that.
rafa.t: Understood. T+30m scale + fallback, T+60m validate. Opening PR 4227: "autoscaler: manual bump for solstice" (link). @jess.m can you do a quick CR?
jess.m: I'll review PR 4227 now. Quick checklist: include rollback hook, metric guard (p99 and error-rate), and a note for CS.
cheng.li: Pushed PR 4231 to reduce batch window and KV cache tuning. Need someone to run canary traffic once the scale lands. @emily.k can you trigger the canary?
emily.k: I can. After scale-up I'll run the canary (100 inference requests with standard smoke prompt). If p99 < 400ms and error rate < 0.5% we mark green.
rafa.t: After canary passes I'll flip routing preference back to dedicated and then slowly remove fallback. Will monitor traces for tail latency.
maria.g: Customer acknowledged and asked to be CC'd on final notification. Also requested progress pings every 15m.
jess.m: Reviewed 4227 - left one small comment about metric thresholds. Will approve once addressed.
cheng.li: Observability: created a temporary dashboard and muted noisy logs. Dash: https://redwood/dash/solstice-pool. Also added KV cache rebuild monitor.
emily.k: Runbook checklist added: https://redwood/runbooks/solstice-sla-esc - includes canary steps, rollback, and CS messaging template.
oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1149, severity=P1, assigned=eng-platform.
rafa.t: TL;DR timeline + owners: T0 owners assigned: rafa.t (routing/scale), cheng.li (batch/config/KV), jess.m (CR + rollout guard), emily.k (canary + CS updates). T+30m scale & config PRs merge, T+45m canary, T+60m finalize + notify CS. If canary fails -> immediate rollback to stable commit and incident escalation.
cheng.li: Note: if KV cache rebuild takes >20m fallback window extends. I'll surface immediately if that happens.
emily.k: Acknowledged. I'll ping CS at :15 and :30 with status updates.
maria.g: Thanks team — customer wants the first ping at +15. Please paste a short status snippet.
rafa.t: Will send pings at +15/+30/+45. Adding notes to INC-2026-1149.
jess.m: Approved PR 4227 after minor fix. Coordinating with cheng for smoke scripts.
emily.k: Can confirm I'll run the smoke once scale is complete and report back.
rafa.t: If anyone sees new 502s after scale, call it out in-channel and I'll initiate rollback.
cheng.li: Monitoring logs and KV rebuild. Will flag if mem edges up.
emily.k: OK — updating CS now ("we have a P1 incident INC-2026-1149, owners assigned, ETA 60m; will send 15m pings").
maria.g: Customer replied: appreciates clear owners and 60m ETA, wants follow-up contact if ETA slips.
emily.k: ack. Will update here and on the incident.
rafa.t: On it. I'll post an update at +15 with scale status. :thumbsup:
jen: thanks everyone (added via thread follow).
